verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that TeamViewer has a Web API documentation page. Nothing indicates that the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console. Probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404, so there is no evidence of the interactive, runnable reference this story requires.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
